# Continued market operation under a protection certificate

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For every process and guard, no course from a configuration leaves the guard exactly when some certificate contains it: a set within the guard that every step keeps; the viability kernel is the largest certificate. For a law of change driven by admissible disturbances, given one admissible disturbance, no history ever leaves the guard exactly when some set containing the start lies within the guard and is closed under every admissible disturbance. The market law is an instance for every parameter set, bound set and start: no admissible guarded history fails the essential floors exactly when such a set of states exists. Under a valid protection certificate the safe rectangle is one, so from a safe initial state with admissible disturbances at every step, the guarded history agrees with the operating history at every natural time without support failure.

Canonical source: [MarketGenerativity.lean](../../../../experiments/market-generativity/formal/MarketGenerativity.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- All public Certificate, Safe and Admissible conditions, including selection, accountability, influence, funding and every support floor; renewal share alone is insufficient.

Quantities represent the specified market relations and supports; essential designates necessary supports. Correct mapping, ethical scope and actual parameters remain separate.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Migrates an existing claim from the original 39 results; the finite-transition check rebuilds and audits inherited source without counting it as new. General laws: checker receipts bound.

Conditional nonfailure; it does not supply entry from unsafe states, a complete basin or inevitable compliance by real markets.

- Low-attractor histories fail with finite support: a physical initial state does not automatically satisfy the certificate, nor does protection cover every ethical consequence. - Leaves.within_not_kernel: the guard alone need not be a certificate; needs_admissible: with no admissible disturbance the history condition holds vacuously and the law fails.
